formats.name: Block look (morph)
formats.stored_in: props.morph on the Puck node in site_config puck:<slug>
formats.written_by: canvas writeLook (tree-editor.ts:1051) and Puck Edit look popup / parts panel
formats.read_by: MorphMark in editor canvas, Puck editor and published RSC route
formats.note: The only look that reaches inside a block, by part name, written as one scoped !important style sheet.

formats.name: Box look (look)
formats.stored_in: props.look on box, words, picture nodes and the page root
formats.note: Same vocabulary as parts, but colours are hex only so a box cannot follow the site palette.

formats.name: Page patches
formats.note: Structural selectors inside declared sections, drawn as !important rules, for pages the editor did not build.

formats.name: Block Style (blkStyle)
formats.written_by: Puck settings sheet only (the canvas never touches it)
formats.note: A wrapper div with token colours, hide on phone or desktop and three hover presets; not seen by the canvas.

formats.name: Dana text style
formats.note: Typeface, weight, case and colour for the words inside one block, with the site's named type roles.

formats.name: Site theme
formats.stored_in: site_themes (page_key '' = site, other keys per page)
formats.note: Values for the site's own colour, font and corner variables, set on html:root.

formats.name: Header and footer looks
formats.note: Looks per named part of the site header and footer, with a reduced key set so the header stays in place.

formats.name: Block tokens
formats.read_by: CSS custom properties on the block root
formats.note: A few named colours, fonts and lengths a block declares, which also move colours derived from them.

capabilities.name: Style manager
capabilities.missing: Only PartStyle keys are editable; anything else needs the developer Code tab.
capabilities.as_block_data: Add keys to PartStyle behind the same sanitiser.

capabilities.name: Selector manager: classes
capabilities.missing: No named reusable looks; classes only keep a converted element's site classes.
capabilities.as_block_data: A per-org library of named looks referenced by id.

capabilities.name: Selector manager: states
capabilities.missing: Hover exists only as three presets on blkStyle; parts and boxes have no states.
capabilities.as_block_data: states hover, focus, active beside base, compiled to pseudo-class rules.

capabilities.name: Layer manager
capabilities.missing: Internals of a block are layers only if declared as parts.
capabilities.as_block_data: Already data: nodes and declared parts.

capabilities.name: Trait manager
capabilities.missing: The settings surface is Puck's sheet, not a house surface.
capabilities.as_block_data: Contract props already describe each setting as data.

capabilities.name: Device manager (breakpoints)
capabilities.missing: No per-breakpoint looks; only hideOn mobile or desktop.
capabilities.as_block_data: at sm and md blocks per part, emitted as media queries.

capabilities.name: CSS composer (real rules)
capabilities.missing: Rules are generated, never written by an author.
capabilities.as_block_data: Structured rules of part, state, breakpoint and declarations, never free CSS.

capabilities.name: Asset manager
capabilities.missing: Pictures on boxes only; no background picture on a block part.
capabilities.as_block_data: A safe background key that passes safeSrc.

capabilities.name: Components with types
capabilities.missing: Authoring a new block visually is not offered.
capabilities.as_block_data: BlockDef plus contract; Detach and templates cover the rest.

capabilities.name: Stores HTML and CSS
capabilities.missing: By design: the house stores data, not HTML.
capabilities.as_block_data: Keep Puck JSON; looks as data compiled to CSS at render.

capabilities.name: Auto layout
capabilities.missing: Works on own boxes; inside a sealed block it can fight the block's own CSS.
capabilities.as_block_data: layout, dir, gap, wrap, items, justify keys, already allowed on parts.

capabilities.name: Constraints and free position
capabilities.missing: Parts of sealed blocks cannot be positioned absolutely.

capabilities.name: Variables, tokens and modes
capabilities.missing: Own-box colours are hex only; there are no modes beyond per-page themes.
capabilities.as_block_data: Colour keys accept a token reference compiled to var(--blk-*); a mode map on the site.

capabilities.name: Component variants and instance overrides
capabilities.missing: morph is the instance override, but no named variants or patterns exist.
capabilities.as_block_data: use:<patternId> plus overrides on the part.

capabilities.name: Styles
capabilities.as_block_data: Named looks usable on parts and boxes.

capabilities.name: Style one instance of a repeated part
capabilities.missing: A repeated part styles every instance; only selection knows the index.
capabilities.as_block_data: item[index] on the part, compiled to the data-edit-item mark.
capabilities.needs_from_block_author: emit editItem marks on repeated elements

capabilities.name: Part health check
capabilities.missing: A selector that stops matching, or a renamed part, silently loses its look.
capabilities.as_block_data: partsHealth reports stored parts matching nothing; aliases map renamed parts.
capabilities.needs_from_block_author: add aliases when renaming a part

cascade.source: root node look and per-page theme row
root base, then states, then breakpoints
hide on screen and other guards stay last

moves.title: One read-only look reader
moves.what_justin_sees: The canvas panel says when a block also has Style set in Puck, and flags clashes with its look.
moves.proof: A script reads every stored page and shows the old emitters and the new reader produce identical CSS, and before/after screenshots match because nothing is written.

moves.title: Hover and phone looks on parts
moves.what_justin_sees: A State switch (normal, hover) and a Device switch (desktop, phone) above the look panel.
moves.proof: No stored page has the new keys so live pixels are unchanged; a test page with hover and phone rules is screenshotted at 390 and 1280 and hostile inputs are added to the smoke scripts.

moves.title: Named looks and part health
moves.what_justin_sees: Save this look as a name, reuse it on other blocks, and a warning when a block no longer has a part he styled.
moves.proof: A page using a pattern compiles to the same CSS as the pattern inlined, partsHealth over all stored pages writes nothing, and existing page pixels are unchanged.
